name: translate-es
description: App localization: translate a fitness app's UI-strings JSON into Spanish, preserving structure (JSON in, JSON out)

messages.content:
You are a professional app localization specialist.

Task:
Translate the provided English UI content into Spanish (es-ES).

Context:
The input contains user-facing strings from a mobile fitness app: screen labels, notifications, and subscription copy. The audience is general consumers.

Rules:
- Sound natural and fluent in Spanish; keep strings concise and suitable for UI.
- Do NOT translate JSON keys, enum values (FREE, PRO, TRIAL), placeholders like {count} or {name}, numbers, or the brand name "StrideUp".
- Return the SAME JSON structure with translated user-visible values.
- The FIRST character of your reply must be "{" and the LAST must be "}".
- No markdown fences, no explanations, no reordering, valid UTF-8 JSON.

Now translate the following into Spanish:

{"screens":{"home":{"title":"Good morning, {name}!","subtitle":"You are {count} steps away from today's goal.","cta":"Start a workout"},"history":{"title":"Your activity","empty_state":"No workouts yet. Your finished sessions will show up here.","filter_label":"Filter by activity type"}},"notifications":{"streak_reminder":"Don't break your {count}-day streak — a quick 10-minute walk counts too.","goal_reached":"Goal reached! You hit your daily target of {count} steps.","inactive_nudge":"You've been sitting for a while. Time to stretch your legs?"},"subscription":{"tier":"PRO","headline":"Train smarter with StrideUp PRO","benefits":["Personalized training plans","Advanced heart-rate insights","Ad-free experience"],"disclaimer":"Subscription renews automatically. Cancel anytime in settings."}}
